focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 深层原因剖析段：表层诱因与结构性根源双层挖掘（Dual-Layer Causal Diagnosis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Cause Opening -> Immediate Operational Driver -> Deeper Institutional Root -> Systemic Compounding. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L005.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 把复杂社会教育现象简单归结为“学生懒（students are lazy）”，缺乏操作成本与评价体系两个层面的结构化深度。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. When effortless text generation meets standardized grading rubrics that fail to penalize hollow reasoning, superficial compliance inevitably crowds out deep inquiry.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 针对“缺少最新基线或算力不公平（Missing Baselines / Fairness）”的补全段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 实验补全与公平性自证段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [直接响应并呈上新表 Direct Fulfilment]：Following your suggestion, we have evaluated [Requested Baselines X and Y] under identical splits and added a parameter-matched variant of our model in Table R3.
S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Direct Fulfilment -> Margin over New Baselines -> Parameter-Reduced Variant (`Ours-Small`) Proof -> Inductive Bias Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 过于单薄，特别是回应参数量质疑时只口头说 does not have many parameters，远不如构造一个缩小版 `Ours-Small` 依然吊打对手有说服力。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Following your suggestion, we benchmarked against the two recent baselines (TimeMixer and FreTS) and evaluated a capacity-reduced variant of our architecture (`DyTS-Lite`) in Table R3. Across all horizons on Weather and ECL, standard DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 9.6% over TimeMixer and 13.4% over FreTS. Furthermore, to ensure strict capacity fairness, `DyTS-Lite` shrinks the hidden dimension to $d=64$—requiring 42% fewer parameters and 55% fewer FLOPs than TimeMixer—yet still outperforms TimeMixer by 6.8% in average MSE. This confirms that our gains stem from structural-scale disentanglement rather than model size.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 让步-反驳段：优雅承认反方合理成分并强力扭转权重（Concession & Refutation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Admittedly (Valid Concern) -> Short-term Reality -> However (Zero-Sum Fallacy Pivot) -> Historical Analogy & Policy Mitigation. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L023.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Some people think robots will take all our jobs and make everyone poor. This is wrong. Robots will create new jobs, and people can learn new skills to find better jobs easily.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 生硬武断（This is wrong, find better jobs easily），既没有共情反方的合理短期阵痛，也没有给出可信的历史类比或转型机制。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Admittedly, critics raise a legitimate concern that autonomous robotics and generative software can displace routine clerical and assembly-line workers. During initial transition phases, rapid automation does create localized employment friction for personnel whose tasks follow rigid, codifiable rules. However, treating technological upgrading as a fixed-pie zero-sum game overlooks how productivity gains expand downstream service and engineering roles. Much as spreadsheet software eliminated manual ledger keeping while multiplying demand for financial data analysts, coupling industrial automation with subsidized reskilling programs enables displaced workers to transition into robot fleet supervision, calibration, and exception handling.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 去机械连接词化：用语义钩子替代 First/Second/Moreover
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 母语学者与高分作文极少每句句首都贴 Firstly, Secondly, Moreover, What is more, In addition 等膏药。应使用语义承接状语（Beyond accuracy gains, / Alongside temporal drift, / At the hardware level,）实现自然递进。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Instead of 'Moreover, X does Y', use: 'Beyond [Summary of Prior Point], [Subject X] also [Verb Y].'
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 一段 5 句话连续用 First, Second, Besides, Moreover，而句子内部毫无词汇呼应，形成典型的中式“八股排比腔”或 AI 列表腔。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: First, our model reduces MSE by 15%. Second, our model uses 40% less memory. Moreover, our model generalizes to unseen sensors.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Our model reduces forecasting MSE by 15.4% across six benchmarks. Beyond accuracy gains, its sparse attention mechanism cuts peak GPU memory by 40%, enabling zero-shot deployment on unseen sensor arrays.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Beyond accuracy gains 承上启下，用 enabling... 自然引出第三层泛化收益，彻底摆脱机械序数词。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 演绎推进（Zoom-In）与归纳提炼（Zoom-Out）双模切换
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 写方法论与议论文主论点段宜用演绎法（Zoom-In：首句抛出概括性规律，随后逐句拆解机理与实例）；写实验分析与看图小作文局部段宜用归纳法（Zoom-Out：先报告具体观测对比，末句提炼背后的理论规律）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Zoom-In: [General Claim] -> [Specific Mechanism] -> [Concrete Data]. | Zoom-Out: [Data Observation A vs. B] -> [Pattern Across Horizons] -> [Theoretical Takeaway].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 在实验分析段只罗列完数据就戛然而止，缺少最后一句 Zoom-Out 的机理升华（Why this pattern matters）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: At horizon 96, our MSE is 0.182. At horizon 336, our MSE is 0.245. At horizon 720, our MSE is 0.310, while Informer reaches 0.612.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: As the prediction horizon extends from 96 to 720 steps, our model's MSE rises modestly from 0.182 to 0.310, whereas Informer degrades sharply to 0.612. This widening performance gap demonstrates that decoupling trend projection from seasonal attention effectively suppresses long-range error compounding.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 第一句整合多步长数据趋势对比，第二句用 This widening performance gap demonstrates that... 完成归纳升华，点明“趋势与季节解耦抑制长程误差累积”的本质原因。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L005 去机械连接词化：用语义钩子替代 First/Second/Moreover）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 把复杂社会教育现象简单归结为“学生懒（students are lazy）”，缺乏操作成本与评价体系两个层面的结构化深度。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Standard dot-product attention measures token similarity purely by instantaneous amplitude alignment, often matching noisy spikes across unrelated time steps. To enforce temporal coherence, we observe that genuine physical interactions between industrial sensors exhibit consistent phase lag across dominant frequencies. Formally, given query and key projections $Q, K \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times d}$, we modulate the attention logits via a phase-alignment mask: $\mathcal{A}(Q, K, V) = \text{softmax}\big(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d}} - \lambda \|\Delta \Phi_{Q,K}\|_1\big)V$, where $\Delta \Phi_{Q,K} \in [-\pi, \pi]^{N \times N}$ denotes the instantaneous Hilbert phase difference matrix and $\lambda > 0$ controls phase selectivity. Penalizing large phase discrepancies prevents spurious attention weights between out-of-phase noise bursts.
